description: Installs Apple's USB and Mobile Device Ethernet (tethering) drivers from the Microsoft Update Catalog, plus Apple Mobile Device Support from iTunes.
notes: This installs only the script. To install the drivers, run it from an elevated (administrator) PowerShell:
Each run downloads iTunes (~200 MB) from apple.com to install AppleMobileDeviceSupport64.msi,
then installs the driver .inf files from Microsoft's Update Catalog with pnputil.
Reconnect the device afterwards; a reboot may be needed.
Scoop does not track the drivers: 'scoop uninstall' removes only the script, the drivers stay installed.
